title: Touchdown Tokyo — Welcome to Japan
description: Land in Tokyo, get your bearings, and dive straight into the electric energy of Shinjuku and Shibuya. Your Japan adventure starts with neon lights, scramble crossings, and your first bowl of real ramen.

activities.title: Arrive & Set Up Base in Shinjuku
activities.description: Clear customs, grab your Suica IC card and pocket WiFi at the airport, then take the Narita Express or Limousine Bus to Shinjuku. Drop bags at your hotel and get oriented.
details: 🎫 Activate your JR Pass at the JR ticket office (bring your exchange voucher)
📱 Rent a pocket WiFi or pick up a SIM card at the airport — essential for navigation
🗼 Shinjuku is the best base: central, well-connected, endless food options

activities.title: Shinjuku Exploration Walk
activities.description: Shake off the jet lag with a walk through Shinjuku's dizzying layers — from the towering skyscrapers of the west side to the intimate alleyways of Omoide Yokocho.
details: 📸 Tokyo Metropolitan Government Building — free observation deck on the 45th floor
🏮 Omoide Yokocho (Memory Lane) — narrow alleys packed with tiny yakitori and ramen shops
🎮 Don Quijote Shinjuku — chaotic multi-floor discount store, great for souvenirs

tips.text: Jet lag is real — don't fight it with caffeine. Walk, get sunlight, eat a good meal, and try to make it to 9pm local time before sleeping.

activities.title: Shibuya Scramble & First Night Vibes
activities.description: Take the train one stop to Shibuya and witness the famous Shibuya Scramble Crossing — up to 3,000 people crossing at once. The energy is unreal, especially at night.
details: 📸 Shibuya Sky observation deck for the aerial scramble view
🐕 Hachiko statue — the famous loyal dog, right outside Shibuya Station
🛍️ Shibuya Center-gai — buzzing pedestrian street full of shops and food

meals.name: Fuunji Tsukemen
meals.description: Tokyo's most famous tsukemen (dipping ramen) — rich, intense fish-pork broth with thick noodles. The line moves fast and it's worth every minute.
meals.meta: 💰 ¥1,000 · 📍 Shinjuku, near south exit · Expect 15-30 min wait

title: Ancient Temples & Akihabara Car Shops
description: Start at Tokyo's oldest temple, then head to the electric town of Akihabara — where anime, electronics, and car culture shops collide.

activities.title: Senso-ji Temple & Nakamise Street
activities.description: Tokyo's oldest and most visited temple. Walk through the iconic Kaminarimon (Thunder Gate), browse the Nakamise shopping street for snacks and souvenirs.
details: ⛩️ Arrive by 8am to beat the crowds
🍡 Try ningyoyaki and melon pan from Nakamise stalls
📸 The five-story pagoda is most photogenic in the morning

meals.name: Pelican Café
meals.description: Famous for its incredibly soft shokupan (milk bread) toast. Simple, perfect Japanese breakfast.

activities.title: Akihabara — Electric Town & Car Culture
activities.description: Akihabara is famous for anime and electronics, but car lovers: browse die-cast car models, racing sim arcades, and automotive manga.
details: 🚗 Tamiya Plamodel Factory — scale model cars, build your own on-site
🎮 Initial D arcade machines everywhere
🛒 Yodobashi Camera — 8 floors of electronics and car gadgets
🏎️ JDM diecast: Tomica, Hot Wheels Japan exclusives, AUTOart

activities.title: Ueno Park & Ameyoko Market
activities.description: Walk through Ueno Park for late cherry blossoms, then dive into the chaotic Ameyoko market for street food and deals.
details: 🏛️ Tokyo National Museum — Japan's oldest
🐼 Ueno Zoo — pandas are a hit with kids
🛍️ Ameyoko — lively market under the train tracks

tips.text: In Akihabara, look for car-themed gashapon (capsule toy) machines — tiny GT-R, AE86, and Supra models for ¥300-500.

activities.title: Tokyo Skytree at Sunset
activities.description: End the day at Japan's tallest structure (634m). The sunset views are breathtaking — on clear days you can see Mt. Fuji.
details: 🎫 Book timed tickets online to skip the line
📸 The Tembo Galleria (450m) has a spiraling glass walkway
🛍️ Tokyo Solamachi mall at the base has 300+ shops

meals.name: Sushi Zanmai
meals.description: Famous 24-hour sushi chain. Fresh, affordable, no-pretense sushi — perfect for families.

title: Odaiba — Cars, Tech & Tokyo Bay
description: Golden Week begins! Head to Odaiba for car heaven: Toyota showcase, teamLab Borderless, life-size Gundam, and the massive Super Autobacs auto parts store.

activities.title: Toyota MEGA WEB / Toyota City Showcase
activities.description: A car lover's dream — Toyota's massive showroom and museum. See concept cars, racing vehicles, and the History Garage with vintage JDM classics.
details: 🏎️ History Garage — classic cars from the 1950s-80s, beautifully restored
🎮 Racing simulators and driving experiences
🚗 Test rides in new models — free, book time slots early
👶 Kids' ride area for younger ones to drive mini cars

tips.text: Golden Week means special events at MEGA WEB — look for car shows and exhibitions. Busy but festive.

activities.title: Super Autobacs Tokyo Bay Shinonome
activities.description: The biggest auto parts store in Tokyo. Three floors: performance parts, car audio, wheels, JDM accessories, and a service center.
details: 🔧 Floor 1: Performance parts — real HKS, GReddy, Cusco parts
🎨 Floor 2: Interior accessories, car audio, LED lighting
🛞 Floor 3: Wheels, tires, and service center
📸 Great photo ops with display cars out front

activities.title: teamLab Borderless
activities.description: One of the most mind-blowing art experiences on earth. Immersive digital art that reacts to your movement — waterfalls, flowers, and infinite mirrors.
details: 🎫 Pre-book tickets (often sells out days ahead)
⏰ Allow 2-3 hours to explore
👗 Wear light-colored clothes — projections show up better on you

meals.name: Bills Odaiba
meals.description: World's best scrambled eggs and fluffy ricotta pancakes with a Tokyo Bay view.

activities.title: Rainbow Bridge Walk & Sunset
activities.description: Walk across the Rainbow Bridge at sunset. See the Statue of Liberty replica and Tokyo's skyline glittering across the bay.
details: 🌅 Sunset around 6:15pm in late April
📸 Rainbow Bridge lights up after dark
🗽 Statue of Liberty replica on the waterfront

meals.name: Yakiniku Like Odaiba
meals.description: Solo-style Japanese BBQ — each person gets their own grill. Fun and interactive for families.

mapPins.desc: Toyota showroom, History Garage & test drives

title: Harajuku, Meiji Shrine & Go-Kart Tokyo
description: Serene Meiji Shrine, wild Harajuku fashion streets, then the ultimate — go-karting through Tokyo's streets in costume.

activities.title: Meiji Jingu Shrine
activities.description: Tokyo's most important Shinto shrine, hidden inside 170 acres of forest. Walk through massive torii gates and feel the calm — steps from Harajuku's chaos.
details: ⛩️ The cypress torii gate is Japan's largest — 12m tall
🌿 The forest was planted in 1920 with 100,000 trees
📝 Write a wish on an ema wooden plaque
👘 You may see traditional Shinto wedding processions

tips.text: Visit before 10am — Golden Week brings big crowds. Morning forest air is magical.

activities.title: Harajuku & Takeshita Street
activities.description: The epicenter of Japanese youth culture. Takeshita-dori is packed with colorful shops, crepe stands, and wild fashion.
details: 🍦 Marion Crepes — the original Harajuku crepe
🛍️ Takeshita Street — cosplay shops, 100-yen stores
🎭 Omotesando — Japan's Champs-Élysées with designer boutiques
🧸 Kiddy Land — 5 floors of toys, great for families

meals.name: Afuri Ramen Harajuku
meals.description: Light yuzu shio ramen — citrus-infused clear broth. A perfect change from heavy tonkotsu.

activities.title: 🏎️ Go-Kart Street Tour — Tokyo
activities.description: THE car experience. Dress up in costume and drive go-karts through actual Tokyo streets — past Tokyo Tower, through Shibuya, under Rainbow Bridge.
details: ⚠️ You MUST have an International Driving Permit (IDP)
📅 Book JapanKart 3+ days ahead (especially Golden Week)
👶 Drivers must be 18+ with IDP. Kids ride as passengers in some tours
📸 GoPro rental available
🌙 Evening tours are best — city lights up around you

meals.name: Gonpachi Nishi-Azabu
meals.description: The restaurant that inspired the Kill Bill fight scene. Robata grill, soba, and yakitori in dramatic wooden interior.

mapPins.desc: Tokyo's most important shrine in 170-acre forest

title: Tsukiji Feast & Daikoku PA Night Meet
description: Morning: eat through Tsukiji Outer Market. Afternoon: upscale Ginza. Night: Daikoku PA, Japan's most legendary car meet where hundreds of modified JDM cars gather.

activities.title: Tsukiji Outer Market Food Crawl
activities.description: The outer market is still the beating heart of Tokyo's food scene. Wander the lanes eating fresh sushi, tamagoyaki, grilled seafood on sticks, and melon.
details: 🍣 Try any shop with a short line — they're all incredible
🥚 Tsukiji Yamacho — famous thick tamagoyaki
🍓 Fresh fruit and Hokkaido melon
🦐 Grilled scallops, crab sticks, and wagyu skewers

tips.text: Tsukiji is best 7-10am. Come hungry, skip hotel breakfast, and graze stall to stall. Budget ¥3,000-5,000.

activities.title: Ginza District & Nissan Crossing
activities.description: Tokyo's most upscale shopping district. Car lovers: don't miss Nissan Crossing — Nissan's flagship showroom with concept cars and GT-R displays.
details: 🏗️ Ginza Six — stunning modern mall with rooftop garden
🚗 Nissan Crossing — concept cars and GT-R displays
🎭 Kabuki-za Theatre — catch a single-act kabuki performance

meals.name: Ginza Kagari
meals.description: Michelin-recommended tori paitan ramen — impossibly silky creamy chicken broth.

activities.title: 🏎️ Daikoku PA Night Car Meet
activities.description: This is IT. Daikoku PA is where Japan's car scene comes alive. Hundreds of modified cars: GT-Rs, Silvias, RX-7s, bosozoku vans, drift missiles, and pristine classics. Engine revs echo off the highway overpasses.
details: 🕘 Peak time: 9pm-1am, busiest Friday/Saturday
🚗 Book a Daikoku tour (Niche Drive, JDM Drift Tours) — ride in an R35 GT-R through the Wangan highway
📸 Bring your camera — cars you've only seen in video games
⚠️ Be respectful: don't rev engines, ask before touching
🛣️ The drive via C1 loop and Wangan highway is half the experience
💰 Tour cost: ~¥15,000-25,000/person including GT-R ride

meals.name: Ichiran Ramen
meals.description: Solo-booth ramen — fill out a form with your preferences, sit in a private booth, and slurp. Perfect post-car-meet fuel.
